l-e-h2-b03-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta "Ahịrịokwu na-amalite na So bụ inverted mgbe niile" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ha.
l-e-h2-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: N'ahịrịokwu na-amalite na So, auxiliary verb ma ọ bụ be verb na-abịa tupu subject mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b03-01.s.s1.r.a: So bụ nke mbụ ma do na-abịa tupu subject. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: So bụ nke mbụ ma have na-abịa tupu subject. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h2-b03-01.s.s1.explain: So n'ahịrịokwu a bụ okwu njikọ pụtara 'ya mere'. Ọ bụghị So pụtara 'so too', ya mere enweghị inversion.

l-e-h2-b03-04.material: Nkwupụta: Okwu na-akwụsị na -ful nwere ihe ọ pụtara dị mma mgbe niile. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-h2-b03-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ okwu nwere ihe ọ pụtara dị mma. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h2-b03-04.s.s2.model.1: -ful pụtara naanị na okwu tupu ya jupụtara, ya mere harmful, nke nwere harm agbakwunyere, enweghị ihe ọ pụtara dị mma.

l-e-h2-b03-05.title: Isiokwu na-abịa mgbe -ever mgbe niile?
l-e-h2-b03-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta "After a wh-ever word, a separate subject always comes" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ha.
l-e-h2-b03-05.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe okwu wh-ever, isiokwu dị iche na-abịa nke mbụ mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b03-05.s.s1.r.a: Isiokwu we na-abịa mgbe wh-ever. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b03-05.s.s1.r.b: Isiokwu it na-abịa mgbe wh-ever. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h2-b03-05.s.s2.model.0: Whoever bụ isiokwu nke wins, ya mere enweghị isiokwu ọzọ mgbe ya, ma nkwupụta na isiokwu dị iche na-abịa mgbe niile adịghị mma.
l-e-h2-b03-05.s.s2.model.1: Whoever n'onwe ya na-arụ ọrụ isiokwu, ya mere ahịrị okwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere n'enweghị isiokwu dị iche.

l-e-h2-b05-01.title: Okwu na-agbanwe n'inversion ọ̀ bụ auxiliary verb mgbe niile?
l-e-h2-b05-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na okwu na-agbanwe tupu isiokwu n'ahịrịokwu a gbanwere bụ auxiliary verb bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: In an inverted sentence, the word that moves before the subject is always an auxiliary verb like have, do, or can. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b05-01.s.s1.r.b: Does na-abịa tupu bus. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-01.s.s1.r.c: Can na-abịa tupu we. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-01.s.s1.r.d: Have na-abịa tupu I. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-01.s.s1.explain: Stood bụ verb nkịtị, ọ bụghị auxiliary verb. Mgbe okwu ebe bịara nke mbụ, verb nkịtị nwere ike ịgbanwe tupu isiokwu.

l-e-h2-b05-02.title: Wish ọ̀ bụ nke megidere eziokwu mgbe niile?
l-e-h2-b05-02.topic: Otú e si eji verb wish
l-e-h2-b05-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ahịrịokwu nwere wish bụ ọchịchọ megidere eziokwu bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b05-02.material: Nkwupụta: Every sentence with wish expresses a wish for something contrary to the facts. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b05-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ọchịchọ megidere eziokwu na ọ bụghị oge opupu ihe ubi ugbu a. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ọchịchọ megidere eziokwu na onye ahụ enweghị ike ịbụ abụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ọchịchọ megidere eziokwu na onye ahụ enweghị ụgbọala. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Wish a bụ ekele pụtara 'Enwere m olileanya na gị ...'. Ọ bụghị ọchịchọ megidere eziokwu kama ọ bụ ọchịchọ ezi ọnọdụ.
l-e-h2-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: I wish you luck on your exam. bụ ekele na-chọ ezi ọnọdụ, ọ bụghị ọchịchọ megidere eziokwu, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-h2-b05-02.s.s2.model.1: Wish dị n'ahịrịokwu a bụ verb nkịtị pụtara 'inwe olileanya', ya mere ọ naghị ekwu banyere ihe megidere eziokwu.

l-e-h2-b05-03.title: Big na large ọ̀ nwere ike ịgbanwe mgbe niile?
l-e-h2-b05-03.topic: Otú e si eji okwu nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara
l-e-h2-b05-03.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na big na large, nke nwere ihe ọ pụtara yiri ibe ha, nwere ike ịgbanwe n'ahịrịokwu ọ bụla bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b05-03.material: Nkwupụta: Big and large, which have similar meanings, can be swapped with each other in any sentence. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s1.o.a: my big sister (nwanne nwanyị nke tọrọ)
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara ọbụlagodi na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ large. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara ọbụlagodi na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ large. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara ọbụlagodi na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ large. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị sị my large sister, ọ pụtara nwanne nwanyị nwere nnukwu ahụ. Big sister pụtara nwanne nwanyị nke tọrọ.
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s2.model.0: Big dị n'my big sister pụtara nke tọrọ, ma ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ large na-eme ka ọ pụta inwe nnukwu ahụ, ya mere nkwupụta na ha nwere ike ịgbanwe mgbe niile ezighi ezi.
l-e-h2-b05-03.s.s2.model.1: Big nwere ihe ọ pụtara nke tọrọ ma large enweghị, ya mere okwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere nke enweghị ike ịgbanwe.

l-e-h2-b05-04.material: Nkwupụta: In a sentence with whether, you can change whether to if. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b05-04.s.s1.r.a: Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ if. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-04.s.s1.r.b: Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ if. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h2-b05-04.s.s1.explain: Na mmalite nke ahịrịokwu, Whether pụtara 'ma ọ bụ ma ọ bụghị' enweghị ike ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ If.

l-e-h2-b05-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ahịrịokwu nwere because na-enye ihe kpatara ọhụrụ banyere ihe bịara tupu ya bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b05-05.material: Nkwupụta: A sentence with because always gives a new reason for what came before. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b05-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-enye ihe kpatara ọhụrụ: enweghị mmiri. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-enye ihe kpatara ọhụrụ: mmiri ozuzo zoro. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-enye ihe kpatara ọhụrụ: okporo ụzọ jụrụ oyi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b05-05.s.s1.explain: It is true because it is true. na-ekwughachi otu okwu ma anaghị enye ihe kpatara ọhụrụ. A na-akpọ ụdị nkọwa a ntụgharị echiche n'okirikiri.

l-e-h2-b06-01.title: Ànyị na-eji 'did' mgbe niile n'inversion nke oge gara aga?
l-e-h2-b06-01.topic: Inversion nke oge gara aga na 'did'
l-e-h2-b06-01.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta "Mgbe ị na-atụgharị usoro ahịrịokwu gbasara oge gara aga, ị na-eji 'did' mgbe niile" ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: N'ahịrịokwu e tụgharịrị usoro ya gbasara oge gara aga nke na-amalite na negative adverb, a na-eji 'did' mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b06-01.s.s1.r.b: E tụgharịrị usoro ya na 'did we'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-01.s.s1.r.c: E tụgharịrị usoro ya na 'did I'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-01.s.s1.r.d: E tụgharịrị usoro ya na 'did I'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-01.s.s1.explain: N'Rarely was the road empty., be-verb 'was' na-agafe n'ihu isiokwu. Be-verb na-aga n'ihu dị ka ọ dị, na-enweghị 'did'.
l-e-h2-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: Rarely was the road empty. enweghị 'did', be-verb 'was' dịkwa n'ihu isiokwu, ya mere nkwupụta na a na-eji 'did' mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu nwere be-verb na-akwaga 'was' n'ihu dị ka ọ dị, ya mere e nwere ihe atụ megidere ebe a naghị eji 'did'.

l-e-h2-b06-02.title: Enwere ike iji 'when' dochie 'if' mgbe niile?
l-e-h2-b06-02.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta "Ịgbanwe 'if' ka ọ bụrụ 'when' na-edebe otu ihe ọ pụtara" ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b06-02.material: Nkwupụta: N'ahịrịokwu nwere 'if', ị nwere ike ịgbanwe 'if' ka ọ bụrụ 'when' ihe ọ pụtara ga-anọgide otu. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Ihe ọ pụtara na-anọgide otu ọbụlagodi na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ 'when'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.r.c: Ihe ọ pụtara na-anọgide otu ọbụlagodi na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ 'when'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.r.d: Ihe ọ pụtara na-anọgide otu ọbụlagodi na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ 'when'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s1.explain: A na-eji 'when' maka ihe ị na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eme n'ezie. Imeri lottery nwere ike ịdịghị mee, ya mere ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ 'when' na-agbanwe ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: Imeri lottery nwere ike ịdịghị mee, ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ 'when' na-eme ka ọ dị ka imeri bụ ihe doro anya, ya mere nkwupụta na ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-02.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji 'when' mgbe ihe ga-eme n'ezie, ya mere enweghị ike ịgbanwe ya n'ahịrịokwu a, nke na-ekwu banyere ihe na-adịghị doro anya.

l-e-h2-b06-03.title: 'over-' ọ̀ na-apụta 'nke ukwuu karịa' mgbe niile?
l-e-h2-b06-03.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta "'over-' tupu okwu pụtara 'nke ukwuu karịa'" ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b06-03.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe a gbakwunyere 'over-' tupu okwu, ọ na-apụta 'nke ukwuu karịa' mgbe niile. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ pụtara ịrụ ọrụ nke ukwuu karịa, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara iri nri nke ukwuu karịa, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ pụtara isi nri nke ukwuu karịa, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s1.explain: 'overlook' apụtaghị 'ilele nke ukwuu karịa'; ọ pụtara 'ịghara ịchọpụta ma gafee'. 'over-' anaghị apụta 'nke ukwuu karịa' mgbe niile.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s2.model.0: 'overlook' apụtaghị ilele nke ukwuu karịa; ọ pụtara ịhapụ ihe ma gafee, ya mere nkwupụta na 'over-' na-apụta 'nke ukwuu karịa' mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-03.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na 'over-', dịka n'overlook, ihe ọ pụtara nwere ike ịdị iche, ya mere ọ bụghị okwu ọ bụla nwere 'over-' pụtara 'nke ukwuu karịa'.

l-e-h2-b06-04.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta "Ọ bụrụ na ahịrịokwu nwere okwu na-amalite na 'wh', ọ bụ ajụjụ" ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h2-b06-04.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu ọ bụla nwere okwu na-amalite na 'wh', dịka who, what, ma ọ bụ when, bụ ajụjụ. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ajụjụ na-ajụ onye kpọrọ oku. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ajụjụ na-ajụ ebe mmadụ bi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ajụjụ na-ajụ ihe nke a bụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s1.explain: N'ahịrịokwu a, 'when' bụ conjunction pụtara 'n'oge nke'. Ọ bụ nkwupụta, ọ bụghị ajụjụ.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s2.model.0: I was asleep when the phone rang. na-ekwu eziokwu, ọ bụghị ajụjụ, ọbụlagodi na ọ nwere 'when', ya mere nkwupụta na ọ bụ ajụjụ mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-04.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrịokwu a, 'when' bụ conjunction na-ejikọ oge, ya mere ọbụlagodi na ọ nwere okwu 'wh', ọ bụghị ajụjụ.

l-e-h2-b06-05.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu ọ bụla na-ejedebe na akara ajụjụ na-arịọ ozi onye na-ekwu okwu na-amaghị. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-h2-b01-06.title: Kedu ozi na-ekpebi ma inversion dị?
l-e-h2-b01-06.goal: Iji chọpụta ihe na-ekpebi usoro okwu nke ahịrịokwu 'Never,' kpebie ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya otú ahụ.
l-e-h2-b01-06.material: Achọrọ m ịkpebi nke ziri ezi, 'Never I have seen snow.' ma ọ bụ 'Never have I seen snow.'
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi a chọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ahịrịokwu ziri ezi?
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ma inversion dị.
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s1.o.c: Eziokwu na Never na-abịa n'ihu kpamkpam nke ahịrịokwu
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s1.o.d: Ma snow bụ aha a na-agụta
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: Ọdịdị nke snow enweghị ihe ọ gbasara inversion.
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s1.explain: Mgbe negative adverb Never na-abịa n'ihu kpamkpam nke ahịrịokwu, ngwaa nyere aka na-aga tupu isiokwu. Ya mere Never have I seen ziri ezi.
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: Inversion ebe ngwaa nyere aka na-abịa tupu isiokwu na-eme naanị mgbe negative adverb dị n'ihu, ya mere ozi ọnọdụ ahụ bụ nke a chọrọ n'ezie.
l-e-h2-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo ahịrịokwu ma ọ bụ afọ enweghị ike ịgbanwe usoro okwu, ya mere ịmara naanị na Never dị n'ihu na-edozi azịza ahụ.

l-e-h2-b04-08.material: The new rule will ___ everyone in school. Họpụta ozi dị mkpa n'ezie iji kpebie ma affect ma ọ bụ effect dabara n'oghere.

l-e-h2-b04-08.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ mmadụ enweghị ihe metụtara ịhọrọ okwu.
l-e-h2-b04-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma iwu ahụ bụ iwu ọhụrụ
l-e-h2-b04-08.s.s1.r.c: Ma ọ bụ nke ọhụrụ adịghị mkpa. Ọkọlọtọ bụ otu esi eji oghere ahụ.

l-e-h2-b04-10.title: Eziokwu ma ọ bụ echiche: gịnị na-ekewa ha?
l-e-h2-b04-10.goal: Iji kewaa ahịrịokwu nke bụ eziokwu na ahịrịokwu nke bụ echiche, họpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-h2-b04-10.material: 'The library opened in 1998.' bụ eziokwu ma 'The library is the best place to study.' bụ echiche. Chọta ọkọlọtọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji kewaa abụọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọkọlọtọ maka ịkewa eziokwu na echiche?
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu ọ bụla na-agwụ na period, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ikewa ha.
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s1.r.b: Echiche nwekwara ike inwe ọnụọgụ n'ime ya.
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo enweghị ihe metụtara ma ọ bụ eziokwu.
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma a pụrụ ilele ya site n'ihe àmà
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s1.explain: A pụrụ ilele eziokwu site n'ihe àmà dị ka ndekọ. Ikpe dị ka best dị iche site n'onye ruo onye, ya mere ọ bụ echiche.
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s2.model.0: A pụrụ ikwenye imeghe n'1998 site n'ndekọ, mana best dị iche site n'onye ruo onye, ya mere ịbụ nke a pụrụ ilele bụ ọkọlọtọ.
l-e-h2-b04-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ ogologo enweghị ihe metụtara ma ọ bụ eziokwu, ya mere ọkọlọtọ bụ ma a pụrụ ilele ya site n'ihe àmà.

l-e-h2-b05-07.material: Chọta ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji hazie ihe mere ụdị verb mgbe insisted ji dị iche n'"The coach insisted that the team practice daily." na "The coach insisted that the team was ready."

l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ mmadụ anaghị agbanwe ụdị verb.
l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo adịghị mkpa. Ihe insisted pụtara bụ ụkpụrụ.
l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s1.o.d: Ma insisted pụtara 'chọrọ' ma ọ bụ 'kwuru na ọ bụ eziokwu'

l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ọ chọrọ, a na-eji ụdị isi, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ekwu na ọ bụ eziokwu, a na-eso tense, ya mere ịchọrọ ịmara ihe insisted pụtara.
l-e-h2-b05-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ mmadụ ma ọ bụ ogologo enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụdị verb, ya mere ma insisted pụtara ọchịchọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta bụ ụkpụrụ.

l-e-h2-b05-09.material: I know ___ you mean. Chọta ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ma "what" ma ọ bụ "that" dabara n'ebe efu.
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.o.a: Ma clause mgbe ebe efu nwere oghere na-efu (object)
l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ adịghị mkpa. Ihe dị mkpa bụ ma clause mgbe ya zuru ezu.

l-e-h2-b05-09.s.s2.model.0: Object nke "mean" na-efu, ya mere a chọrọ "what". Nke ahụ mere ị ga-eji lelee ma clause mgbe ya zuru ezu.

l-e-h2-b05-10.s.s1.r.a: Ogologo enweghị ike igosi ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta.
l-e-h2-b05-10.s.s1.o.c: Kedu ihe mere mbụ wee kpatara nke ọzọ?
l-e-h2-b05-10.s.s1.o.d: Kedu ahịrịokwu ka e dere mbụ n’ederede?
l-e-h2-b05-10.s.s1.r.d: Usoro e si dee ihe na usoro ha si mee nwere ike ịdị iche.
l-e-h2-b05-10.s.s1.explain: Ọkpọkọ jụrụ oyi, ya mere mmiri apụtaghị. Ihe mere mbụ wee kpatara nke ọzọ bụ ihe kpatara ya.

l-e-h2-b06-06.material: Hardly ___ do I eat sweets. Họpụta ozi ị chọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ma 'ever' ma ọ bụ 'any' dabara n'oghere ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s1.o.a: Ma oghere ahụ na-ekwu 'ugboro ole' ma ọ bụ 'ole'
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s1.r.c: 'do' bụ ngwaa nyere aka n'ikpe abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ bụ otu maka okwu abụọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s1.explain: 'do I eat' bụ ebe anyị na-ekwu ugboro ole anyị na-eri, ya mere 'ever' dabara. 'any' chọrọ aha ozugbo mgbe ya, dịka n'any sweets.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s2.model.0: Oghere ahụ bụ ebe anyị na-ekwu ugboro ole anyị na-eri, ya mere 'ever' dabara, nke pụtara na ị ghaghị ilele ma ọ na-ekwu 'ugboro ole' ma ọ bụ 'ole'.
l-e-h2-b06-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede ma ọ bụ oge ngwaa anaghị ekewa 'ever' na 'any', ya mere ọkwa ahụ bụ ma ọ na-ekwu ugboro ole ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụ.

l-e-h2-b06-07.title: Ọ̀ bụ 'could' ma ọ bụ 'would' mgbe 'wish'?
l-e-h2-b06-07.goal: Họpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ n'ezie iji chọpụta ma 'could' ma ọ bụ 'would' dabara mgbe 'wish', ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h2-b06-07.material: Họpụta ozi ị chọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ma 'could' ma ọ bụ 'would' dabara n'ebe efu n'"I wish I ___ swim." na "I wish my phone ___ stop ringing."
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.o.a: Ma 'wish' dị n'mmalite kpamkpam nke ahịrị okwu
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.r.a: Ọnọdụ anaghị emetụta. Ụkpụrụ bụ ihe ị chọrọ ịgbanwe.
l-e-h2-b06-07.s.s1.o.b: Ole okwu isiokwu nke ahịrị okwu nwere

l-e-h2-b04-11.material: Here comes the bus. / Here it comes. / Down the hill rolled the ball. / Down the hill it rolled. Chọta iwu maka usoro nke subject na verb n'ahịrịokwu anọ ndị a.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta ziri ezi, site n'iji iwu a chọtara site n'ikpe ndị ahụ?
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.a: Na subject noun verb na-abịa nke mbụ, ma na subject pronoun usoro na-anọgide otu
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.b: Mgbe place adverb na-abịa nke mbụ, verb na-abịa tupu subject mgbe niile
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Na subject pronoun dị ka Here it comes, usoro anaghị agbanwe.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.c: Gbakwunye do mgbe niile mgbe place adverb
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: E nwere naanị comes na rolled, enweghị do.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.d: Ọbụna mgbe place adverb na-abịa nke mbụ, usoro na-anọgide otu mgbe niile
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: N'Here comes the bus, verb na-abịa tupu subject.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe place adverb na-abịa nke mbụ, subject noun na-aga mgbe verb, mana subject pronoun dị ka it na-anọgide tupu verb.

l-e-h2-b04-12.title: Ọdịiche dị n'etiti would have, could have, na might have
l-e-h2-b04-12.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu maka auxiliary verb n'result clause nke hypothetical banyere oge gara aga site n'ọtụtụ ikpe, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b04-12.material: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus. (n'ezie ga-ejide ya) / ..., I could have caught it. (ga-enwe ike ijide ya) / ..., I might have caught it. (nwere ike ijide ya) Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.a: Auxiliary verbs atọ niile nwere otu ihe pụtara
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: Ihe pụtara dị n'parentheses dị iche ibe ha.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.b: would bụ nke doro anya, could bụ ohere, might bụ nke na-adịghị doro anya
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.c: would bụ nke na-adịghị doro anya ma might bụ nsonaazụ doro anya
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.c: would bụ nke doro anya ma might bụ nke na-adịghị doro anya.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: could bụ ohere, ma nsonaazụ doro anya bụ would.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.explain: N'hypothetical banyere oge gara aga, would have na-egosi nsonaazụ doro anya, could have na-egosi ihe nwere ike ime, ma might have na-egosi nsonaazụ na-adịghị doro anya.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: would pụtara n'ezie ga-ejide ya, could pụtara ga-enwe ike ijide ya, ma might pụtara nwere ike ijide ya, ya mere auxiliary verb na-agwa ka nsonaazụ si doo anya.

l-e-h2-b04-13.material: transport (iburu gafee) / import (iweta n'ime) / export (ịzipụ pụọ) / portable (nke a pụrụ iburu). Chọta ihe port pụtara n'ime okwu ndị a.
l-e-h2-b04-13.s.s1.r.b: Ha pụtara ịkwaga na iweta n'ime, ya mere ha dị iche na ịkwụsị.
l-e-h2-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: export bụ izipụ ihe n'èzí, ya mere 'ịzụta' anaghị akọwa ya.
l-e-h2-b04-13.s.s1.explain: port pụtara 'ibu'. transport bụ ibu gafee, import bụ ibu bata, portable bụkwa nke enwere ike ibu.
l-e-h2-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: Okwu anọ ahụ niile nwere ihe ọ pụtara nke ịkwaga ma ọ bụ ibu, ya mere port pụtara ibu.
l-e-h2-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: import na-ebu ihe bata, export na-ebukwa ihe pụọ, ya mere port nwere ihe a na-ekekọrịta nke ibu.

l-e-h2-b04-14.title: Gịnị ka to-infinitive mgbe okwu ajụjụ pụtara?
l-e-h2-b04-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu maka ihe to-infinitive mgbe okwu ajụjụ pụtara site n'ọtụtụ ikpe, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b04-14.material: I don't know what to say. / Please show me how to open it. / We decided where to meet. / Nobody knows when to stop. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.o.a: A chọrọ isiokwu tupu to mgbe niile
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.r.a: N'ikpe ndị ahụ, enweghị isiokwu tupu to.
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.r.b: what to say pụtara ihe a ga-ekwu. Ọ bụghị ebumnuche.
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.o.c: Ọ pụtara ihe e mere n'oge gara aga
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.r.c: To-infinitive na-atụ aka n'ihe a ga-eme n'oge ọzọ.
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụ noun phrase pụtara 'gịnị/otu esi/ebee ka a ga-eme ihe'
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s1.explain: what to say pụtara ihe a ga-ekwu. Okwu ajụjụ + to-infinitive na-eje ozi dị ka object mgbe know, show, na decide.
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: what to say pụtara ihe a ga-ekwu, where to meet pụtakwa ebe a ga-ezute, ya mere ọ nwere ihe 'gịnị/ebee ka a ga-eme' pụtara.
l-e-h2-b04-14.s.s2.model.1: N'ikpe anọ niile ọ bụ object nke ngwaa dịka know, show, ma ọ bụ decide, ya mere ọ na-eje ozi dị ka noun phrase.

l-e-h2-b04-15.material: painter : brush / writer : pen / farmer : plow. Chọta iwu maka otú okwu mbụ na okwu nke abụọ si metụta ibe ha n'ụzọ atọ a.
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.o.a: Nke mbụ na nke abụọ bụ okwu nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: painter na brush enweghị otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.o.b: Nke mbụ na nke abụọ bụ ihe megidere ibe ha
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.r.b: painter na brush abụghị ihe megidere ibe ha.
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.o.c: Nke mbụ bụ ọrụ, nke abụọ bụkwa ngwá ọrụ e ji arụ ọrụ ahụ
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.o.d: Nke mbụ bụ ngwá ọrụ, nke abụọ bụkwa ọrụ
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.r.d: Usoro ahụ na-aga azụ. painter bụ ọrụ.
l-e-h2-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Onye na-ese ihe na-eji brush arụ ọrụ, onye edemede na-eji pen, onye ọrụ ugbo na-eji plow. Nke mbụ bụ ọrụ, nke abụọ bụkwa ngwá ọrụ ya.

l-e-h2-b05-11.title: Gịnị bụ iwu maka usoro okwu mgbe “as did” gasịrị?
l-e-h2-b05-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ usoro okwu mgbe as, nke pụtara “otu a kwa,” gasịrị; chọta iwu ahụ, kwuo ya ma nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b05-11.material: Wages rose, as did prices. / Cats like fish, as do dogs. / The first test was hard, as was the second. Chọta iwu usoro okwu na-eso as n’ihe atụ ndị a.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe ngwaa bu isiokwu ụzọ, ọ pụtara “otu a kwa.”
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.b: A na-eji do mgbe niile mgbe as gasịrị.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: “as was the second” ji was mee ihe.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.c: Isiokwu na-abịa mbụ mgbe as gasịrị.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: N’ime “as did prices,” ngwaa did na-abịa mbụ.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.d: Nkwupụta na-emegide nke bu ya ụzọ na-eso as.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile nwere otu ihe dị na akụkụ bu ha ụzọ.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe [auxiliary verb ma ọ bụ be-verb + isiokwu] na-eso as, dịka did prices, do dogs, na was the second, ọ pụtara “otu a kwa.”
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ atọ niile, ngwaa na-abịa tupu isiokwu mgbe as gasịrị ma pụtara “otu a kwa”; ya mere nke a bụ iwu usoro okwu.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Did, do, na was na-agbanwe ka ha kwekọọ na ngwaa dị n’ahịrịokwu mbụ; ya mere mgbe as gasịrị, were ngwaa mbụ tinye ya n’ihu.

l-e-h2-b05-12.title: Gịnị ka “should have p.p.” na-ekwu?
l-e-h2-b05-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ ihe “modal verb + have p.p.” na-egosi; chọta iwu, kwuo ya ma nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b05-12.material: I should have called. (akpọghị m) / You shouldn’t have worried. (i nwere nchegbu) / We could have won. (anyị emerighị) / We needn’t have hurried. (anyị mere ngwa ngwa) Chọta iwu ha niile nwekọrọ.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.a: Ọ na-ekwu kpọmkwem ihe mere n’oge gara aga.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ekwu ihe megidere eziokwu dị n’ime akara nkwado.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.b: Ọ na-ebu amụma ihe ga-eme n’ọdịnihu.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.r.b: Ha niile na-ekwu maka ihe ndị merela n’oge gara aga.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.c: Ọ na-ekwu ihe na-eme ugbu a.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: “have p.p.” na-ekwu maka oge gara aga.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.d: Ọ na-ekwu ihe megidere ihe mere n’ezie n’oge gara aga.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.explain: “should have p.p.” pụtara “kwesịrị ime ya ma emeghị”; “could have p.p.” pụtara “nwere ike ime ma emeghị”; ya mere ha na-akọ oge gara aga dị iche na eziokwu.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-ekwu “should have called” n’agbanyeghị na akpọghị, na “should not have worried” n’agbanyeghị na ụjọ tụrụ; ya mere ọ bụ oge gara aga megidere ihe mere n’ezie.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Ihe atụ anọ ahụ niile na-ekwu ihe dị iche na eziokwu dị n’ime akara nkwado; ya mere ha na-egosi ọnọdụ megidere eziokwu gara aga.

l-e-h2-b05-13.material: prepay (kwụọ tupu oge eruo) / preview (lee tupu oge eruo) / prehistoric (tupu akụkọ ihe mere eme) / prewash (saa tupu oge eruo). Chọta iwu pre- n’ihe atụ ndị a.

l-e-h2-b05-13.s.s1.explain: pre- na-agbakwunye ihe “tupu oge eruo.” preview pụtara ile tupu oge eruo, prehistoric pụtara tupu akụkọ ihe mere eme.
l-e-h2-b05-13.s.s2.model.0: prepay, preview, na prewash niile bụ ihe a na-eme tupu oge eruo; ya mere pre- pụtara “tupu oge eruo.”
l-e-h2-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: prehistoric pụtara tupu akụkọ ihe mere eme; ya mere pre- pụtara oge tupu.

l-e-h2-b06-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke mgbe enwere ike ịhapụ nnochi aha relative, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b06-14.material: The film I saw was long. (ziri ezi) / The film that I saw was long. (ziri ezi) / The dog that barks is mine. (ziri ezi) / The dog barks is mine. (ezighi ezi) Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.a: Enwere ike ịhapụ ya mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ihe, ma ọ bụghị mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isiokwu
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.b: Enwere ike ịhapụ nnochi aha relative mgbe niile
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.r.b: 'The dog barks is mine' bụ ahịrị okwu na-ezighi ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.c: Enweghị ike ịhapụ nnochi aha relative ma ọlị
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrị okwu ụfọdụ ka ziri ezi mgbe a hapụrụ ya, dị ka 'The film I saw'.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.o.d: Enwere ike ịhapụ ya mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isiokwu, ma ọ bụghị mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ihe
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.r.d: 'that' nke na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ihe nke 'I saw' ka a hapụrụ.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s1.explain: N'"the film (that) I saw", 'that' bụ ihe nke 'saw', ya mere enwere ike ịhapụ ya. N'"the dog that barks", 'that' bụ isiokwu nke 'barks', ya mere enweghị ike ịhapụ ya.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s2.model.0: 'that' dị n'ahịrị okwu ihe nkiri bụ ihe nke 'saw', ya mere a hapụrụ ya, ma 'that' dị n'ahịrị okwu nkịta bụ isiokwu nke 'barks', ya mere ịhapụ ya na-eme ahịrị okwu ahụ adịghị mma. Ya mere ụkpụrụ bụ ọrụ ya.
l-e-h2-b06-14.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị okwu ahụ ka dị mgbe a hapụrụ naanị dị ka ihe, ya mere a ga-edebe nnochi aha relative na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isiokwu.

l-e-h2-b06-15.title: Gịnị na-abịa mgbe 'because of' na mgbe 'because'?
l-e-h2-b06-15.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ihe na-abịa mgbe 'because of' na 'because', wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b06-15.material: Because of the rain, the match stopped. / Due to the noise, I woke up. / Because it rained, the match stopped. Chọta iwu site n'ihe atụ ndị a.
l-e-h2-b06-15.s.s1.o.a: Nkebiokwu aha na-abịa mgbe 'because of', ma nkebiokwu na-abịa mgbe 'because'
l-e-h2-b06-15.s.s1.o.c: Nkebiokwu aha na-abịa mgbe atọ niile
l-e-h2-b06-15.s.s1.r.d: N'"because of the rain", 'the rain' abụghị nkebiokwu.
l-e-h2-b06-15.s.s1.explain: Nkebiokwu aha dị ka 'the rain' ma ọ bụ 'the noise' na-abịa mgbe 'because of' na 'due to', ma nkebiokwu dị ka 'it rained' na-abịa mgbe 'because'.
l-e-h2-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: 'The rain' na 'the noise' bụ nkebiokwu aha, ma 'it rained' bụ nkebiokwu nwere isiokwu na ngwaa, ya mere ihe na-abịa mgbe dị iche.
l-e-h2-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna mgbe ha na-enye otu ụdị ihe kpatara, 'because of' na 'due to' na-ewere nkebiokwu aha ma 'because' na-ewere nkebiokwu, ya mere ọdịdị dị iche.

l-e-h2-b07-03.title: Gịnị na-eso Moreover?
l-e-h2-b07-03.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu sitere n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ ihe na-eso njikọ okwu na-agbakwunye ozi, jirizie ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-e-h2-b07-03.material: The hotel was cheap. Furthermore, it was clean. / The film was long. Moreover, it was dull. / The test was hard. In addition, it was timed. Chọpụta ọrụ njikọ okwu ndị a.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.o.a: Ahịrịokwu nke abụọ na-ekwu ihe megidere nke mbụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: cheap na clean bụ ihe ọma abụọ; ha abụghị ihe na-emegiderịta onwe ha.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.o.b: Ahịrịokwu nke abụọ bụ ihe kpatara nke mbụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrịokwu nke abụọ abụghị ihe kpatara nke mbụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.o.c: Ahịrịokwu nke abụọ na-agbakwunye ọdịnaya n’otu akụkụ ahụ nke mbụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.o.d: Ahịrịokwu nke abụọ bụ ihe atụ nke mbụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụghị ihe atụ kama ọ na-agbakwunye isi ihe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Furthermore, Moreover, na In addition na-agbakwunye otu isi ihe n’otu akụkụ ahụ dị n’ahịrịokwu gara aga.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: N’ọnọdụ atọ ahụ, ihe na-aga n’otu ntụziaka na ahịrịokwu gara aga na-eso; ya mere njikọ okwu ahụ na-agbakwunye ozi n’otu akụkụ.
l-e-h2-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: Ihe ọma na-esochi ihe ọma, ihe ọjọọ esochikwa ihe ọjọọ, dịka cheap wee clean, long wee dull; ya mere iwu bụ ịgbakwunye ozi n’otu akụkụ.

l-e-h2-b01-16.title: Ahịrịokwu ole ka chọrọ inversion?
l-e-h2-b01-16.goal: Tụ anya ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu ndị chọrọ inversion iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b01-16.material: Okwu mbụ nke ahịrịokwu edemede 6: Seldom / Last night / Rarely / Every morning / Never / In the park. A na-agbanwe usoro nke ahịrịokwu na-amalite na adverb njụ.
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ezigbo atụmatụ nke ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu ndị chọrọ inversion?
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s1.r.a: Ị hapụrụ Seldom, Rarely, na Never.
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s1.r.c: Last night, Every morning, na In the park abụghị okwu njụ.
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbasaara ya ikwu na mmalite ndị na-abụghị okwu njụ na-enweta inversion nakwa.
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s1.explain: Seldom, Rarely, na Never bụ adverbs njụ atọ, ya mere ha chọrọ inversion. Ndị ọzọ anaghị achọ.
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: Seldom, Rarely, na Never bụ adverbs njụ, ya mere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 3 chọrọ inversion ma ndị ọzọ adabaghị.
l-e-h2-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: Mmalite na-egosi oge ma ọ bụ ebe anaghị achọ inversion, ya mere site na adverbs njụ 3 oke 2 ruo 3 ziri ezi.

l-e-h2-b01-17.title: Nyocha nke mmadụ 20 ọ̀ nwere ike ịgwa anyị banyere onye ọ bụla?
l-e-h2-b01-17.goal: Tụ anya ihe nsonaazụ nyocha na-agwa banyere otu niile iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b01-17.material: N'klọb nwere ndị otu 400, a jụrụ mmadụ 20, ma 15 n'ime ha chọrọ nzute Saturday. Kedu ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị kacha isi kọwaa nsonaazụ a?
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.o.a: Ihe nlele dị obere, ya mere enweghị ike ikwu ihe ọ bụla
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụlagodi na ọ dịghị doro anya, anyị nwere ike ịkọwa usoro ọ na-aga.
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.r.b: Ọ kwupụtara oke nke ihe nlele dị ka ọnụọgụ kpọmkwem maka otu niile.
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ ezie na ọtụtụ n'ime otu niile nwere ike ịchọ ya, ọ dịghị doro anya
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.o.d: Ihe na-erughị ọkara nke ndị otu niile chọrọ ya
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.r.d: 15/20 bụ 75%, ya mere nke a na-emegide data ahụ.
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s1.explain: 15 n'ime 20 bụ 75%. Anyị nwere ike ichepụta usoro ọ na-aga, ma n'ihi na ihe nlele dị obere, anyị enweghị ike ikwu ọnụọgụ kpọmkwem.
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 75% chọrọ ya, o yikarịrị ka ọtụtụ mmadụ n'otu niile na-achọkwa ya, ma n'ihi na ihe nlele dị obere, anyị enweghị ike ịdị n'ezie.
l-e-h2-b01-17.s.s2.model.1: A jụrụ naanị mmadụ 20, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ikwu kpọmkwem 300; ọ kwesịrị ekwesị ịkọwa naanị usoro ọ na-aga.

l-e-h2-b02-17.material: Akụkọ na-ekwu: 'Nearly half of the 90 students walk to school.' Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eje ije gaa ụlọ akwụkwọ.

l-e-h2-b02-17.s.s1.r.d: Fọrọ nke nta ka ha niile abụghị 'fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ọkara'.

l-e-h2-b02-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọkara bụ 45, fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ọkara dịkwa ntakịrị karịa nke ahụ, ya mere ị nwere ike ịtụ atụmatụ ihe dị ka 40-44.
l-e-h2-b02-17.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ọ gafere 45, ọ karịrị ọkara, ya mere 40-44 dabara n'okwu fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ọkara.

l-e-h2-b02-19.material: Tụọ ọkwa iwe site n'adịghị ike ruo ike: annoyed < angry < ( ? ). Ị chọrọ igosi ọnọdụ "iwe dị oke egwu".
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu dabara nke kacha mma?
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ọkwa nke ịbụ onye a na-ewe iwe ntakịrị.
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ọkwa adịghị ike dị ka annoyed.
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ okwu pụtara ịbụ onye e merụrụ ahụ karịa iwe.
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s1.explain: furious pụtara "iwe na-ere ọkụ", nke ka angry ike nke ukwuu. annoyed na irritated bụ ọkwa adịghị ike nke ịbụ onye a na-akpasu.
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s2.model.0: furious pụtara ọnọdụ iwe dị oke egwu, nke ka angry ike, ya mere ọ dabara nke kacha mma.
l-e-h2-b02-19.s.s2.model.1: annoyed na irritated adịghị ike ma upset pụtara ịbụ onye e merụrụ ahụ, ya mere furious dabara n'ọkwa nke iwe dị oke egwu.

l-e-h2-b02-20.title: Oke nke however much na-ekpuchi
l-e-h2-b02-20.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ oke ọnụọgụ nke however much na-atụ aka na ya, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h2-b02-20.material: 'However much money you earn, you cannot buy time.' Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ndị ahịrịokwu a gụnyere.
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe kacha mma ahịrịokwu a pụtara?
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.o.a: Ị pụghị ịzụta oge naanị mgbe ị nwere obere ego
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.r.a: however much gụnyere ikpe niile, ma ọnụọgụ dị ntakịrị ma ọ bụ buru ibu.
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.o.b: Ọ dịghị mkpa ego ole ị na-enweta, ị pụghị ịzụta oge
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ọtụtụ ego, ị nwere ike ịzụta oge
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu ahụ na-ekwu na ị pụghị ịzụta oge.
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.o.d: Ọ pụtara na ego ị na-enweta bụ ọnụọgụ e kpebiri
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ naghị ekpebi ọnụọgụ ma na-agụnye ọnụọgụ ọ bụla.
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s1.explain: however much pụtara "n'agbanyeghị ole ...", ya mere ọ pụtara na otu nkwubi okwu ahụ dị n'agbanyeghị ka ọnụọgụ buru ibu.
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s2.model.0: however much pụtara "n'agbanyeghị ole", ya mere ọ na-agụnye ọbụna ikpe ebe ọnụọgụ buru ibu ma ị ka pụghị ịzụta oge.
l-e-h2-b02-20.s.s2.model.1: Nkwubi okwu bụ otu ma ọnụọgụ dị ntakịrị ma ọ bụ buru ibu, ya mere ọ na-agụnye ọbụna ikpe nke ọnụọgụ kacha ukwuu.

l-e-h2-b03-16.title: Ime atụmatụ ihe Little did I know pụtara
l-e-h2-b03-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ ogo ihe Little pụtara, họrọ ọnụọgụ kwesịrị ekwesị ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-h2-b03-16.material: N’ime “Little did I know that the road was closed,” Little dị n’isi pụtara ihe na-adịghị mma bụ “fọrọ nke nta ka m ghara.”
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.o.a: Amaara m nke ọma na emechiri ụzọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Little apụtaghị “ama nke ọma”; ọ pụtara na amaara m nke nta nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.o.b: O siri m ike ịmata na e mechiri ụzọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.o.c: Amaara m naanị na e mechiri ụzọ ahụ ntakịrị.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.r.c: Ị gwakọtara “a little” na Little dị n’isi ahịrịokwu.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.o.d: E mechighị ụzọ ahụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-akọwa ókè m si mara, ọ bụghị otú e si mechie ụzọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s1.explain: Little dị n’isi ahịrịokwu bụ adverb na-adịghị mma pụtara “fọrọ nke nta ka m ghara.” Ọ pụtara na amaghị m nke ọma na e mechiri ụzọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: Little dị n’isi nwere echiche ọjọọ nke na-egosi na ịmara dị ntakịrị; ya mere buru amụma na ọ fọrọ nke nta ka m ghara ịma.
l-e-h2-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ adverb ọjọọ Little, ọ bụghị a little; ya mere ọ pụtaghị “ama ntakịrị,” kama “fọrọ nke nta ka m ghara ịma.”

l-e-h2-b03-17.title: “Ọtụtụ n’ime ha nwere afọ ojuju” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu?
l-e-h2-b03-17.goal: Mee atụmatụ oke ihe “most” pụtara, họrọ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-h2-b03-17.material: Peeji ngwaahịa ahụ kwuru “Most reviewers are happy.” N’ime nyocha 12, 5 bụ mkpesa, 7 enwe afọ ojuju.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.o.a: Ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ nyocha niile gosiri afọ ojuju.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: 5 n’ime 12 bụ mkpesa, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ha niile.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.o.b: Ihe dị ka 1/4 nke nyocha gosiri afọ ojuju.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.r.b: 7/12 karịrị ọkara ma dịkwa ukwuu karịa 1/4.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.o.c: Afọ ojuju karịrị ọkara ntakịrị; ya mere “most” ziri ezi naanị ntakịrị.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: E nwere mkpesa 5 na nyocha afọ ojuju 7; ya mere ihe megidere nke ahụ bụ eziokwu.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s1.explain: 7/12 dị ihe dị ka 58%. Ọ dị ntakịrị karịa ọkara; ya mere most ziri ezi, ma ọ bụghị ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ha niile.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: 7/12 bụ ihe dị ka 58%, ntakịrị karịa ọkara; ya mere mee atụmatụ na most ziri ezi ntakịrị.
l-e-h2-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: E nwekwara mkpesa 5; ya mere o siri ike ikwu na ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ onye ọ bụla nwere afọ ojuju. Ikwu na ọ dị ntakịrị karịa ọkara ziri ezi.

l-e-h2-b03-18.goal: Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu echiche ndị megidere eziokwu, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.

l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s1.prompt: Ahịrịokwu ole na-ekwu maka ọnọdụ e chepụtara nke megidere eziokwu?

l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s1.explain: ①③⑤ jiri were, had, na had known; ha na-emegide eziokwu. ②④ bụ ọnọdụ present nwere ike ime n’ezie.

l-e-h2-b03-20.title: Ime atụmatụ ugboro ole ụlọ akwụkwọ ga-emechi mgbe snow dara
l-e-h2-b03-20.goal: Mee atụmatụ ugboro ọnọdụ whenever nwere ike ime, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-h2-b03-20.material: Iwu ụlọ akwụkwọ: “Whenever it snows, school closes.” Oge oyi a, snow dara ụbọchị 6.
l-e-h2-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha dabara maka ụbọchị ole ụlọ akwụkwọ mechiri?

l-e-h2-b03-20.s.s1.r.b: A na-emechi ụlọ akwụkwọ mgbe ọ bụla snow dara; ya mere ọ bụghị ugboro 3.
l-e-h2-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: A na-emechi ụlọ akwụkwọ ụbọchị snow niile; ya mere ọ karịrị ugboro 2.
l-e-h2-b03-20.s.s1.explain: E mechiri ụlọ akwụkwọ n’ụbọchị snow 6 niile; ya mere ọ bụ opekata mpe ugboro 6. Enwere ike inwe mmechi ndị ọzọ na-abụghị n’ihi snow.
l-e-h2-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: Iwu ahụ bụ na ụlọ akwụkwọ na-emechi whenever snow dara; ya mere o mechiri n’ụbọchị 6 ahụ niile. Mee atụmatụ opekata mpe ugboro 6.
l-e-h2-b03-20.s.s2.model.1: Amaghị mmechi n’ụbọchị snow na-adịghị; ya mere kama ọnụọgụ kpọmkwem, ikwu opekata mpe ugboro 6 ziri ezi.

l-e-h2-b04-16.title: Okwu ole ka nchịkọta nke ederede okwu 450 kwesịrị inwe?
l-e-h2-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ogologo kwesịrị ekwesị maka nchịkọta iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h2-b04-16.material: Onye nkụzi kwuru ka e chịkọta ederede okwu 450 ruo ihe dị ka 1/5 nke ogologo mbụ ya. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka okwu ole nchịkọta ahụ kwesịrị inwe.
l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ogologo kwesịrị ekwesị maka nchịkọta ahụ?
l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 1/50 nke mbụ. Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu karịa 1/5.
l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ọkara. Ọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu karịa 1/5.
l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s1.explain: 1/5 nke 450 bụ 90. Ọbụlagodi ịgbaa 450 gburugburu ruo 500 na-enye ihe dị ka 100, ya mere ihe dị ka 90 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 450 ÷ 5 = 90, nchịkọta nke ihe dị ka okwu 90 dabara kpọmkwem.
l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbaa 450 gburugburu ruo 500, 1/5 nke 500 bụ 100, ya mere 90, nke dị nso na 100, dabara kpọmkwem.

l-e-h2-b04-17.title: Okwu ole amaghị ka ọ ka dị mfe ịgụ?
l-e-h2-b04-17.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ole n'ime ederede ị nwere ike ịgụ n'udo iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b04-17.material: Ọ bụrụ na okwu amaghị bụ 5% ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị nke ederede, a na-ekwu na ọ dị mfe ịgụ. Ederede nwere okwu amaghị 30 n'okwu 400. Tụọ atụmatụ ma enwere ike ịgụ ya n'udo.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.o.a: Dị mfe: ihe dị ka 2% okwu amaghị
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: 30÷400 bụ ihe dị ka 7.5%, ọ bụghị 2%.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.o.b: Dị mfe: ihe dị ka 5% okwu amaghị
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.r.b: 30÷400 bụ ihe dị ka 7.5%, nke karịrị 5%.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.o.c: Siri ike: ihe dị ka 7.5% okwu amaghị
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.o.d: Siri ike: ihe dị ka 15% okwu amaghị
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: 15% ga-abụ okwu 60. Okwu 30 bụ ihe dị ka 7.5%.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.explain: 5% nke 400 bụ okwu 20, 30 dịkwa karịa nke ahụ. Ọ bụ ihe dị ka 7.5%, ya mere ọ bụ ederede siri ike.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: 5% nke 400 bụ okwu 20 ma 30 karịrị nke ahụ, ya mere o siri ike ịgụ ya n'udo.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Ikewa 30 site na 400 na-enye ihe dị ka 7.5%, nke karịrị ọkwa 5%, ya mere ọ bụ ederede siri ike.

l-e-h2-b04-18.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu inversion ị ga-ede n'omume iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b04-18.material: Ị na-ede ahịrịokwu inversion 5 kwa ụbọchị ma na-eme omume kwa ụbọchị ruo izu 3 (ụbọchị 21). Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu ole ị ga-ede n'ozuzu.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu ole n'ozuzu?
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: 5 kwa ụbọchị bụ ihe dị ka ụbọchị 3 uru, ọ bụghị ụbọchị 21 uru.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka otu izu uru. Izu 3 karịrị nke ahụ.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: 5 kwa ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 21 dị anya n'ezughị 1000.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.explain: Ịgbaa 21 gburugburu ruo 20, 5×20=100. Ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 100 dabara kpọmkwem.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbaa ụbọchị 21 gburugburu ruo ụbọchị 20, 5×20=100, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 100.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Na 5 kwa ụbọchị ruo izu 3, ị na-ede ahịrịokwu 5 ugboro 21, ya mere ọ dị ihe dị ka 100.

l-e-h2-b04-19.material: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ idegharị ahịrịokwu 12 site na wish, ị nwekwara nkeji 30. Ịrụzi ndị mbụ 3 were nkeji 6. Tụọ atụmatụ ogologo oge ọ ga-ewe ma ị debe otu ọsọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.prompt: Ogologo oge ole ka ọ ga-ewe iji rụzie 12 niile?
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: Nkeji 6 maka 3 pụtara nkeji 2 maka 1, ya mere nkeji 12 dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: 12 bụ okpukpu 4 nke 3, ya mere ọ bụ nkeji 24. Nkeji 36 dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: Ị mịkọrọ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu site na nkeji 6, ya mere atụmatụ gị buru ibu nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 6 maka 3 pụtara nkeji 2 maka 1. Ahịrịokwu 12 na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 24, ya mere ị nwere ike imecha n'ime nkeji 30.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-ewe nkeji 2 maka 1 ma e nwere 12, ya mere ọ na-ewe nkeji 24 ị nwekwara ike imecha n'ime nkeji 30.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: 12 bụ okpukpu 4 nke 3, okpukpu 4 nke nkeji 6 bụkwa nkeji 24, ya mere enweghị oge na-ezughị.

l-e-h2-b04-20.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ -ever clauses dị n'ederede iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b04-20.material: N'ederede nke okwu 90, -ever clause dịka whenever ma ọ bụ whoever na-apụta otu ugboro n'okwu 18 ọ bụla n'nkezi. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka -ever clauses ole dị n'ederede a.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka -ever clauses ole dị?
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere otu n'okwu 18, e nwere ọtụtụ karịa otu n'okwu 90.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.r.c: 18 bụ oghere dị n'etiti okwu, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.r.d: 90 bụ ọnụọgụ okwu. Ọ pụtaghị otu n'okwu ọ bụla.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.explain: 90 kewara site na 18 bụ 5. Na otu n'okwu 18 ọ bụla, e nwere ihe dị ka 5.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 90÷18=5, e nwere ihe dị ka -ever clauses 5.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s2.model.1: Otu na-apụta n'okwu 18 ọ bụla, ya mere 18 na-abanye n'90 ugboro 5, nke pụtara ihe dị ka 5.

l-e-h2-b05-16.title: Nkeji ole ka a ga-eji gụọ ederede okwu 600?
l-e-h2-b05-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ oge a ga-eji gụọ akụkọ okwu 600, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-16.material: Akụkọ ahụ nwere okwu 600, ị na-agụkwa ihe dị ka okwu 200 n’ime nkeji 1. Mee atụmatụ oge ịgụ ya niile.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.prompt: Ogologo oge ole ka a ga-eji gụọ ya niile?
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na e gụọ okwu 200 n’ime nkeji 1, a ga-agụ ihe dị ka okwu 100 n’ime sekọnd 30.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.r.b: Ọsọ ahụ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 20 n’ime nkeji. Ọ dị nwayọọ nke ukwuu. (1)
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọsọ ahụ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 3 n’ime nkeji. Ọ dị nwayọọ nke ukwuu. (1)
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s1.explain: 600÷200=3. Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ okwu 200 n’ime nkeji 1, ọ ga-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 3.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: 600 kewara na 200 bụ 3; ya mere ọ ga-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 3.
l-e-h2-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: Okwu 200 ugboro 3 bụ okwu 600; ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 3.

l-e-h2-b05-17.title: Okwu ole ka ị na-amụta n’otu afọ?
l-e-h2-b05-17.goal: Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu ọhụrụ a ga-amụta n’otu afọ, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-17.material: Ị na-amụta okwu ọhụrụ 45 kwa ọnwa ruo 1 afọ (ọnwa 12). Mee atụmatụ ngụkọta okwu ole ị ga-amụta.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.prompt: N’ihe dịka ole ka ngụkọta ya ga-abụ?
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ nke otu ọnwa; ọ bụghị ọnwa 12.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.r.b: Ọ erubeghị ọbụna ihe dị ka ọkara afọ.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.r.d: 45 kwa ọnwa ruo ọnwa 12 adịghị eru 5000 ma ọlị.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na i mee 45 ka ọ bụrụ 50, 50×12=600; ọ bụrụ na i mee ya ka ọ bụrụ 40, ọ bụ 480. Ihe dị ka 500 dabara.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i were 45 dịka n’etiti 40 na 50 ma mụbaa na 12, ị ga-enweta 480 ruo 600; ya mere ihe dị ka 500.
l-e-h2-b05-17.s.s2.model.1: Ị na-agbakwunye okwu 45 ugboro 12; ya mere ihe dị ka 500 dabara.

l-e-h2-b05-18.title: Ugboro ole ka inversion expression dị n’ime edemede?
l-e-h2-b05-18.goal: Mee atụmatụ inversion expressions ole dị n’edemede, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-18.material: A na-ekwu na n’edemede iwu, inversion malitere na adverb ọjọọ na-apụta ihe dị ka otu ugboro n’ime okwu 250. Mee atụmatụ ugboro ole n’edemede okwu 1000.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ugboro ole ka ọ ga-apụta?
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ otu ugboro n’ime okwu 250, n’ime okwu 1000 ọ karịrị otu ugboro.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.r.c: Ugboro 40 ga-abụ otu ugboro n’ime okwu 25, nke na-abụkarị nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.r.d: 250 bụ oghere dị n’etiti okwu, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ ugboro.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s1.explain: 1000÷250=4. Ọ bụrụ na ọ pụta otu ugboro n’ime okwu 250, ọ ga-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 4 n’ime okwu 1000.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s2.model.0: 1000÷250=4; ya mere ọ ga-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 4.
l-e-h2-b05-18.s.s2.model.1: Okwu 250 dabara n’ime okwu 1000 ugboro 4; ya mere ihe dị ka ugboro 4.

l-e-h2-b05-19.title: Olee otú ihe nwere “were to” nwere ike isi mee?
l-e-h2-b05-19.topic: Ihe nwere ike ime n’ime “were to”
l-e-h2-b05-19.goal: Mee atụmatụ ohere “were to” na-egosi, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-19.material: Otu onye kwuru, “If the train were to arrive early, we would catch the 9:00 bus.” Mee atụmatụ ohere onye na-ekwu chere na ụgbọ oloko ga-abịa n’oge.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ohere ya bụ ọkara na ọkara, ị gaghị eji “were to.”
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na o doro anya na ọ ga-eme, ị ga-asị “If the train arrives early.”
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na o doro anya, ị gaghị eche ya; ị ga-eji “will” kwuo ya.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.explain: “If ... were to ...” bụ echiche ihe a na-ahụ dị ka ihe na-agaghị ekwe omume. Ọ dabara n’ihe na-adịkarị ụkọ, dịka 5%.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s2.model.0: “were to” na-eche ihe na-agaghị eme ngwa ngwa; ya mere ịtụ ya dịka 5% dabara.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ihe nwere ike ime, a na-eji present tense; ya mere “were to” na-egosi na onye na-ekwu chere na o yighị ka ọ ga-eme.

l-e-h2-b05-20.goal: Mee atụmatụ ajụjụ indirect ole dị na mpempe omume, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-20.material: Mpempe omume nwere ajụjụ wh- 24, 1/4 n’ime ha bụ ajụjụ indirect. Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ajụjụ indirect.
l-e-h2-b05-20.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ole ka ajụjụ indirect dị?
l-e-h2-b05-20.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ dị nnọọ ala karịa 1/4 nke 24.
l-e-h2-b05-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ọkara; ọ bụghị 1/4.

l-e-h2-b05-20.s.s2.model.0: 24 kewara na 4 bụ 6; ya mere e nwere ajụjụ indirect ihe dị ka 6.
l-e-h2-b05-20.s.s2.model.1: 1/4 bụ otu ìgwè n’ime ìgwè 4; ya mere 6 n’ime ajụjụ 24 bụ indirect.

l-e-h2-b06-16.title: Ihe dị ka mmadụ ole bụ 30% nke 80?
l-e-h2-b06-16.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ mmadụ kwenyere n'nyocha, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b06-16.material: Ha jụrụ ndị otu 80, ma 30% kwenyere n'iwu ọhụrụ. Tụọ anya ihe dị ka mmadụ ole kwenyere.
l-e-h2-b06-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ 10% nke 80. 30% bụ ugboro atọ nke ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-16.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụrụ 30% dị ka mmadụ 30 n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ karịrị ọkara nke 80.

l-e-h2-b06-17.title: Ogologo oge ole ka ọ ga-ewe iji chọọ okwu n'akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu?
l-e-h2-b06-17.goal: Tụọ anya oge ọ na-ewe iji chọọ okwu n'akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b06-17.material: E nwere okwu amaghị 5 n'otu peeji, ma ọ na-ewe sekọnd 20 iji chọọ otu okwu n'akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu. Tụọ anya oge akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu mgbe ị na-agụ peeji 12.
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka ogologo oge ole ka ọ ga-ewe iji chọọ okwu?
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ nkeji 10 n'peeji, nke dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka sekọnd 100 maka naanị otu peeji. Maka peeji 12 ọ dị ogologo karị.
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ nkeji 100 n'peeji, nke dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s1.explain: Otu peeji bụ 5×20=sekọnd 100, ma peeji 12 bụ sekọnd 1200. Sekọnd 1200 bụ nkeji 20.
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s2.model.0: Otu peeji na-ewe sekọnd 100 ma peeji 12 na-ewe sekọnd 1200, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 20.
l-e-h2-b06-17.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye sekọnd 100 ugboro 12 na-enye sekọnd 1200, ya mere ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ nkeji na-enye ihe dị ka nkeji 20.

l-e-h2-b06-18.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ahịrị okwu a tụgharịrị n'ahịrị edemede, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b06-18.material: Ahịrị edemede nwere ahịrị okwu 12. Were ya na ahịrị okwu a tụgharịrị nke na-etinye okwu na-ekwu mmegide n'ihu na-apụta n'ahịrị okwu nke 4 ọ bụla. Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ahịrị okwu a tụgharịrị n'ahịrị edemede a.

l-e-h2-b06-19.material: N'ịzụ ide ahịrịokwu conditional 25, 4 n'ime 5 mbụ ka e dere nke ọma. Were na ndị fọdụrụ ziri ezi n'otu ọnụọgụ, ma tụọ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu ziri ezi n'ime 25.

l-e-h2-b06-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọ ga-apụta na ọ nweghị otu ahịrịokwu na-ezighị ezi.

l-e-h2-b06-20.material: Anya ole ka ọdụ ụgbọ okporo ígwè dị? Mmadụ na-ejikarị ije ije 5km n'otu awa. Ọ na-ewe nkeji 15 ije ije ruo ọdụ ụgbọ okporo ígwè. Tụọ anya ahụ.
l-e-h2-b06-20.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka anya ole ka ọ dị ruo ọdụ ụgbọ okporo ígwè?

l-e-h2-b06-20.s.s1.r.c: Na 5km n'otu awa, 10km n'nkeji 15 agaghị ekwe omume.
l-e-h2-b06-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ anya ị nweghị ike ije n'nkeji 15.

l-e-h2-b07-07.material: Ọkwa òtù n'ụlọ akwụkwọ nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 600 na-ekwu 'Dozens of students joined the book club.' Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ sonyere nke kacha dabara adaba.

l-e-h2-b01-21.goal: Soro, otu n'otu, ọrụ nke inversion n'ahịrịokwu Not until, ma ọ bụ njikọ dị n'etiti ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, iji chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma dozie ya.
l-e-h2-b01-21.material: Ọrụ iji dozie 'Not until the bell rang the students left.': ①Not until phrase dị n'ihu kpamkpam. ②Ya mere a chọrọ inversion. ③Gbanwee usoro n'ime Not until clause: Not until did the bell ring. ④Nkwubi okwu: Not until did the bell ring the students left.
l-e-h2-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: Ikpe na phrase ahụ dị n'ihu kpamkpam ziri ezi.
l-e-h2-b01-21.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe Not until bịara nke mbụ, a chọrọ inversion, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-e-h2-b01-21.s.s1.r.d: ④ na-aga n'ihu naanị na nsonaazụ na-ezighi ezi nke ③, ya mere ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-e-h2-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Inversion na-eme n'main clause na-esote, ọ bụghị n'Not until clause. Not until the bell rang did the students leave ziri ezi.
l-e-h2-b01-21.s.s2.model.0: N'③ e chere n'njehie na ebe ị ga-agbanwe usoro bụ Not until clause, ya mere ④ adịghịkwa mma, ma a ga-edozi main clause ka ọ bụrụ did the students leave.
l-e-h2-b01-21.s.s2.model.1: Clause mgbe Not until na-anọgide dịka ọ dị, ma auxiliary verb nke main clause ga-aga n'ihu isiokwu, ya mere ③ bụ ebe mbụ na-ezighi ezi.

l-e-h2-b05-21.goal: Soro ngwọta nke ime conditional ọjọọ n’enweghị if, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.

l-e-h2-b05-22.title: Ebe nkọwa nke "otherwise" gabigara ụzọ?
l-e-h2-b05-22.goal: Soro, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, ngwọta na-agụ "otherwise" dị ka if-clause, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h2-b05-22.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta na-agụ 'Take a coat; otherwise you will catch a cold.' site n'ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ "if". ① "otherwise" na-atụ aka n'ọnọdụ megidere nke bịara tupu ② Ihe bịara tupu bụ iburu uwe oyi ③ Ya mere "otherwise" bụ 'if you take a coat' ④ Ihe pụtara: If you take a coat, you will catch a cold.
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọ na-atụ aka n'ọnọdụ megidere nke bịara tupu
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s1.r.a: Ọ kọwara ihe "otherwise" pụtara nke ọma.
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s1.o.b: ② Ihe bịara tupu bụ iburu uwe oyi
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s1.o.c: ③ "otherwise" bụ 'if you take a coat'
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s1.o.d: ④ If you take a coat, you will catch a cold
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s1.explain: "otherwise" pụtara "if not". Ọ na-aghọ 'if you do not take a coat', pụtara na ọ bụrụ na ị buru uwe oyi, ị ga-ejide oyi.
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s2.model.0: "otherwise" bụ ọnọdụ megidere, ya mere ọ ga-abụrịrị 'if you do not take a coat', nke na-eme ③ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h2-b05-22.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-atụ aka n'ihe megidere nke bịara tupu, ya mere iji "take" dị ka ọ dị n'③ adịghị mma.

l-e-h2-b05-23.title: Ebe nkọwa nke "autobiography" gabigara ụzọ?
l-e-h2-b05-23.topic: Ịchọpụta ihe pụtara site n'mgbọrọgwụ okwu
l-e-h2-b05-23.goal: Soro, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, ngwọta na-achọpụta ihe "autobiography" pụtara site n'mgbọrọgwụ ya, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h2-b05-23.material: Nke a bụ usoro ichọpụta ihe "autobiography" pụtara. ① "bio-" pụtara 'ndụ' ② "graph" pụtara 'ihe e dere' ③ "auto-" pụtara 'onye ọzọ' ④ Ya mere ọ bụ 'akụkọ ndụ nke onye ọzọ dere'.
l-e-h2-b05-23.s.s1.r.a: Ndụ ziri ezi, dị ka n'"bio" nke "biology".
l-e-h2-b05-23.s.s1.r.b: "graph" ziri ezi n'ihi na ọ pụtara ide na idekọ.
l-e-h2-b05-23.s.s1.o.d: ④ Akụkọ nke onye ọzọ dere
l-e-h2-b05-23.s.s1.explain: "auto-" pụtara 'onwe'. "autobiography" bụ 'akụkọ ndụ nke onye dere onwe ya', ya bụ, autobiography.
l-e-h2-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: "auto-" anaghị apụta onye ọzọ kama ọ pụtara onwe, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi, ma okwu ahụ pụtara autobiography.
l-e-h2-b05-23.s.s2.model.1: Dị ka n'"automatic", "auto-" pụtara 'n'onwe ya', ya mere akụkọ ndụ nke onye dere onwe ya ziri ezi.

l-e-h2-b05-24.title: Ebe "Whenever it will rain," gabigara ụzọ?
l-e-h2-b05-24.goal: Soro, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, ngwọta na-ekpebi tense nke "Whenever" clause, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h2-b05-24.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta na-agbanwe 'We stay inside whenever it rains' gaa n'asụsụ Bekee. ① "Whenever" clause bụ adverbial clause nke oge ② N'clause nke oge, a na-ede ọdịnihu site na "will" ③ Whenever it will rain, ... ④ Mechaa: Whenever it will rain, we stay inside.
l-e-h2-b05-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi na ọ bụ adverbial clause nke oge.
l-e-h2-b05-24.s.s1.o.b: ② N'clause nke oge, a na-ede ọdịnihu site na "will"
l-e-h2-b05-24.s.s1.explain: N'clause nke oge, ọbụna ihe ga-eme n'ọdịnihu ka a na-ede n'present tense. Whenever it rains, we stay inside. ziri ezi.
l-e-h2-b05-24.s.s2.model.0: N'clause nke oge ị naghị eji "will" kama present tense, ya mere ② ezighị ezi.
l-e-h2-b05-24.s.s2.model.1: Iji "will" n'② mere ya "it will rain", ma ọ ga-edozịrị ka ọ bụrụ "it rains".

l-e-h2-b07-01.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ịgbanwe She realized the mistake ka ọ malite na Only then. ① Only then bụ limiting adverbial ② Mgbe ọ bịara mbụ, mee inversion ③ did na-abịa mgbe isiokwu gasịrị ④ Ya mere Only then she did realize the mistake.
l-e-h2-b07-01.s.s1.o.a: ① Only then bụ limiting adverbial.

l-e-h2-b07-01.s.s1.o.c: ③ did na-abịa mgbe isiokwu gasịrị.
l-e-h2-b07-01.s.s1.explain: N’inversion, did na-abịa tupu isiokwu, ya bụ Only then did she realize the mistake.

l-e-h2-b04-28.material: N'The school put off the trip until May., gbanwee put off ka ọ bụrụ otu okwu ihe omume.

l-e-h2-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara na ha kwughachiri ya.
l-e-h2-b04-28.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na e kagburu ya, ha agaghị aga na May ọbụna. Nke ahụ dị iche na ịtọgbọ.

l-e-h2-b04-29.material: Chọta ajụjụ ọzọ na-ajụ ihe kpatara, nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara dị ka 'How come you are late?'

l-e-h2-b04-29.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nkebiokwu na-ada ka ihe na-adịghị mma nke na-ajụ otú ị si bịa n'oge gara aga.

l-e-h2-b04-30.title: Ịgbanwe 'All ... are ...' ka ọ bụrụ if
l-e-h2-b04-30.topic: Ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ if-then
l-e-h2-b04-30.goal: Kwuo ụzọ ọzọ isi kwuo 'All dolphins are mammals.' n'ụdị ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe ọ pụtara ji bụrụ otu.
l-e-h2-b04-30.material: Chọta ahịrị okwu nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara dị ka 'All dolphins are mammals.' nke na-ezo aka n'otu anụmanụ dị ka it ma na-eji if.
l-e-h2-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ mgbanwe. E nwere anụ ara na-abụghị dolphin.
l-e-h2-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ nkwupụta ụgha na ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị dolphin, ọ bụghị anụ ara.
l-e-h2-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nkwupụta ụgha na dolphins abụghị anụ ara.
l-e-h2-b04-30.s.s1.explain: 'All A are B' bụ otu ihe ahụ dị ka 'If it is A, it is B.' Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ dolphin, ọ bụ anụ ara. Ọ bụrụ na ị tụgharịa ya, ihe ọ pụtara na-agbanwe.
l-e-h2-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Dolphin ọ bụla bụ anụ ara, ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe ahụ dị ka ikwu na ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ dolphin, ọ bụ anụ ara.
l-e-h2-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Dolphin na-abịa mgbe if ma anụ ara ga-abịa n'nsonaazụ, ya mere ịgbanwe usoro na-agbanwe ihe ọ pụtara.

l-e-h2-b05-26.title: Ikwu "Neither can I" n'ụzọ ọzọ
l-e-h2-b05-26.goal: Gbanwee okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dị ka 'Neither can I.' ka ọ bụrụ udi ọzọ (ahịrịokwu, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe pụtara ji bụrụ otu.
l-e-h2-b05-26.material: A kwuru, 'I can't swim.' ma B zara, 'Neither can I.' Chọta ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dị ka ihe B kwuru.
l-e-h2-b05-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nwere ihe megidere pụtara: "I can swim too".
l-e-h2-b05-26.s.s1.r.c: A naghị eji "can" na "either" ọnụ dị otú a.
l-e-h2-b05-26.s.s1.r.d: N'ahịrịokwu negative ị na-eji "either", ọ bụghị "too".
l-e-h2-b05-26.s.s1.explain: "Neither can I" pụtara 'I cannot either'. "I can't either." nwere otu ihe pụtara, ma a na-eji "either" n'ahịrịokwu negative.
l-e-h2-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: "Neither can I" pụtara na m enweghịkwa ike ime ya, ya mere ọ bụ otu dị ka "I can't either."
l-e-h2-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: N'ọgwụgwụ ahịrịokwu negative na-abịa "either", ọ bụghị "too", ya mere "I can't either." ziri ezi.

l-e-h2-b05-30.material: Chọta ahịrịokwu e dere ọzọ ka ọ pụta otu ihe dị ka 'It is not unlikely that it will rain.'
l-e-h2-b05-30.s.s1.r.b: "certainly" bụ ịdị n'aka nke ka ike nke ukwuu karịa "not unlikely".
l-e-h2-b05-30.s.s1.r.c: "not unlikely" anaghị apụta na mmiri agaghị ezo.

l-e-h2-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: "unlikely" bụ nke e mere negative, ya mere ọ pụtara nke nwere ohere, ma ọ bụ otu dị ka "quite possible".

l-e-h2-b06-26.s.s1.r.c: Ọ pụtara ihe megidere: na ha na-abịa ọzọ.

l-e-h2-b01-33.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ gbasara ụdị ngwaa n’ime if-clause nke ọnọdụ ọdịnihu, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h2-b01-33.material: Ọ pụtara “ọ bụrụ na m nwere oge echi, m ga-akpọ gị.” A: If I will have time tomorrow, I will call. B: If I have time tomorrow, I will call.
l-e-h2-b01-33.s.s1.o.a: A: A ga-etinye will ka ọdịnihu doo anya.
l-e-h2-b01-33.s.s1.r.a: N’ime nkebi oge na ọnọdụ, a na-eji ụdị present ọbụna mgbe a na-ekwu maka ọdịnihu.
l-e-h2-b01-33.s.s1.r.b: A tinyere will n’ime nkebi ọnọdụ, ya mere ọ na-ada na-adịghị mma.
l-e-h2-b01-33.s.s1.r.c: B bụ ụdị ziri ezi maka nkebi ọnọdụ.
l-e-h2-b01-33.s.s1.o.d: B: Jiri ụdị present n’ime nkebi ọnọdụ.
l-e-h2-b01-33.s.s1.explain: Maka ọnọdụ ga-eme n’ọdịnihu nke nwere ike ime, jiri present n’ime if-clause na will n’ime nkebi bụ isi. B ziri ezi.

l-e-h2-b01-34.title: Ụzọ abụọ e si achọpụta ihe misread pụtara

l-e-h2-b01-34.material: Anyị chọrọ ịmata misread n’ime “I misread the sign and turned left.” A: Wuo ihe ọ pụtara site na prefix mis- (“n’ụzọ na-ezighị ezi”) na read. B: Ebe ọ dị ka miss (“ịghara ijide”), ghọta ya dịka “ịghara ịgụ.”
l-e-h2-b01-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Wuo ihe ọ pụtara site na prefix na mgbọrọgwụ okwu.
l-e-h2-b01-34.s.s1.r.b: Ị gaghị ama ihe okwu pụtara site n’otú e si asụpe ya naanị.
l-e-h2-b01-34.s.s1.r.c: B dabere n’otú okwu ahụ si dị, ọ bụghị n’usoro ya n’ezie.

l-e-h2-b05-32.title: Kedu okwu na-enye ihe kpatara iburu umbrella?
l-e-h2-b05-32.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ nke ikwu ịkwado maka mmiri, họrọ nke dabara karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-32.material: Ịchọrọ ikwu na mmadụ kwesịrị ịkwado tupu mmiri ezo. A: Take an umbrella if it rains. B: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke dabara karịa n'ihe pụtara nke ịkwado tupu oge?
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.a: A: "if" pụtara iburu umbrella mgbe mmiri na-ezo
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: "if" bụ ọnọdụ pụtara na ị na-eme ya mgbe ahụ, ma ọ bụrụ na mmiri ezo. Ọ bụghị ịkwado tupu oge.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.b: B: "in case" pụtara iburu ya tupu oge n'ihi na mmiri nwere ike ịzo
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: "if" bụ ọnọdụ maka mgbe mmiri zoro.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.d: Ọ nweghị nke nwere ihe metụtara ịkwado
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.explain: "in case ~" bụ ịkwado n'ihi na 'ọ nwere ike ~'. "if ~" bụ ọnọdụ ị na-eme ihe ozugbo ihe mere.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: "in case it rains" pụtara iburu ya tupu oge n'ihi na mmiri nwere ike ịzo, ya mere B dabara.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: "if it rains" bụ ọnọdụ maka mgbe mmiri ezoro, ya mere ọ dabaghị n'ihe pụtara nke ịkwado tupu oge.

l-e-h2-b05-33.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ nke iji okwu maka onye nwere oke obi ụtọ, họrọ nke dabara karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h2-b05-33.material: Ịchọrọ ịkọwa onye meriri onyinye ma nwee oke obi ụtọ. A: The winner was pleased. B: The winner was thrilled.
l-e-h2-b05-33.s.s1.o.a: A: "pleased" na-egosi ogo nke 'oke obi ụtọ'
l-e-h2-b05-33.s.s1.r.a: "pleased" bụ banyere 'obi ụtọ', nke adịghị ike karịa "thrilled".

l-e-h2-b05-34.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka okwu dabara mgbe "the book", họrọ nke dabara karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.

l-e-h2-b05-34.s.s1.o.b: B: "that" bụ relative pronoun na-akọwa "the book"
l-e-h2-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri "what", a na-ekwughachi "the book".
l-e-h2-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Mgbe antecedent "the book" nọ tupu ya, jiri "that". "what" pụtara 'ihe nke', ya mere ọ nwere antecedent ahụ n'ime ya.
l-e-h2-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: Antecedent dị, "the book", ya mere "that" dabara.
l-e-h2-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: "what" na-ejide antecedent ahụ n'ime ya, ya mere mgbe "the book" a na-ekwughachi ya ma ọ dabaghị.

l-e-h2-b06-33.title: Ọ bụ implied ka ọ bụ inferred?
l-e-h2-b06-33.goal: Tụlee okwu abụọ e ji akọwa ihe akụkọ tụrụ aro, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h2-b06-33.material: Akụkọ ahụ ekwughị ya kpọmkwem ma tụọ aro na ọnụ ahịa ga-arị elu. A: Akụkọ ahụ implied na ọnụ ahịa ga-arị elu. B: Akụkọ ahụ inferred na ọnụ ahịa ga-arị elu.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.o.a: A: imply pụtara na onye na-ekwu na-atụ ihe aro.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.o.b: B: infer pụtara na ederede na-atụ ihe aro.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.r.b: infer pụtara na onye na-agụ na-achọpụta ihe site n’ihe ngosi.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.r.c: Okwu abụọ ahụ dị iche: otu bụ ọrụ onye na-ekwu, nke ọzọ bụ nke onye na-agụ.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.explain: imply bụ mgbe onye na-ekwu tụrụ ihe aro; infer bụ mgbe onye na-ege ntị ma ọ bụ na-agụ na-achọpụta ya site n’ihe ngosi.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s2.model.0: Akụkọ ahụ bụ ihe tụrụ aro; ya mere A nke jiri imply ziri ezi.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s2.model.1: infer bụ ihe onye na-agụ na-eme; ya mere iji akụkọ ahụ dịka isiokwu na B na-ada adịghị mma.

l-e-h2-b07-08.title: Ihe ọ pụtara ọ̀ na-agbanwe ma e nwere comma ma ọ bụ na enweghị?
l-e-h2-b07-08.goal: Maka ahịrịokwu abụọ, otu nwere na otu na-enweghị commas gburugburu who clause, tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h2-b07-08.material: ⓐ My sister who lives in Daegu is a nurse. ⓑ My sister, who lives in Daegu, is a nurse. Tụnyere nkwupụta na-akọwa ọdịiche dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ.
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke kacha kọwaa ọdịiche dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ?
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.o.a: Ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu kpamkpam ma e nwere comma ma ọ bụ na enweghị
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: Comma na-agbanwe ọrụ nke who clause, ya mere ihe e ji aghọta ya dị iche.
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.o.b: ⓑ na-atụ aro na enwere ike ịbụ ụmụnne nwanyị karịa otu
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.r.b: ⓑ bụ nkọwa agbakwunyere, ya mere ọ na-adị ka e nwere naanị otu nwanne nwanyị.
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.o.c: ⓐ na-atụ aro na enwere ike ịbụ ụmụnne nwanyị karịa otu
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.o.d: Enwere ike ịgbanwe who n'ⓑ ka ọ bụrụ that
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.r.d: A pụghị ịgbanwe who nwere comma ka ọ bụrụ that.
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s1.explain: Who clause n'ⓐ na-ahọpụta 'nwanne nwanyị nke ọ bụla,' ya mere enwere ike ịbụ ụmụnne nwanyị ọtụtụ. ⓑ na-agbakwunye nkọwa gbasara nwanne nwanyị ahụ.
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: Who clause n'ⓐ na-ahọpụta nwanne nwanyị nke ọ bụla, ya mere ọ na-atụ aro na enwere ike ịbụ ọtụtụ ụmụnne nwanyị.
l-e-h2-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: ⓑ bụ nkọwa agbakwunyere mgbe comma, ya mere ọ na-adị ka e nwere otu nwanne nwanyị, ihe ọ pụtara dịkwa iche n'ⓐ, nke na-ahọpụta otu.

l-e-h2-b01-39.material: N’akwụkwọ nkwado, anyị chọrọ ịkọwa onye na-achọ ọrụ n’echiche ọma bụ “na-eji ego akpachapụ anya.” Ọnọdụ: ① Pụtara iji ego nke ọma ② Nwere echiche ọma ③ Dabara n’ederede iwu.
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu mezuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ nke ọma?
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s1.r.a: O nwere echiche ọjọọ siri ike nke “onye anyaukwu.”
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe e ji ya kọwaa mmadụ, ọ na-aghọ nkatọ na onye ahụ bụ onye anyaukwu.
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ekwu okwu ọjọọ banyere onye na-echekwa ego gabiga ókè.
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s1.explain: frugal bụ okwu ọma pụtara ịchekwa ego n’enweghị imefusị. Ndị ọzọ nwere echiche ọjọọ nke anyaukwu.
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s2.model.0: frugal pụtara iji ego akpachapụ anya ma dabara n’ederede iwu; ya mere ọ kacha dabara.
l-e-h2-b01-39.s.s2.model.1: stingy, cheap, na miserly niile nwere ụda ịta mmadụ ụta; ya mere frugal dabara n’akwụkwọ nkwado.
